notInstalled.blocks: sidebar-app, dialog-sidebar, and queued-stack are composed in apps/app

localPatches.src/lib/icon-context.tsx: Default icon set imports #lib/icons (Lucide with shared size and stroke) instead of lucide-react directly; adds panel-left-collapsed and panel-right-collapsed slots (frame with an inset handle).
localPatches.src/components/sidebar-core.tsx: SidebarTrigger shows the panel icon while open and the collapsed (inset handle) icon while collapsed, instead of one icon in both states.
localPatches.src/components/card.tsx: next/link replaced by a plain anchor so the package stays router-agnostic.
localPatches.src/components/file-thumbnail.tsx: PDF.js worker is bundled through a Vite ?url import instead of loaded from jsDelivr at runtime.
localPatches.src/hooks/use-fluid-hover.ts: holdInGaps option (keeps the highlight while the pointer is between items); used by HoverScope on the marketing nav.
localPatches.src/lib/shape-context.tsx: The pill shape keeps inputs on the rounded radius (rounded-lg); buttons, rows and containers stay pill.
localPatches.src/components/select.tsx: The default (bordered) trigger is filled with the surface tint instead of drawing an outline. Popup rows sit 4px apart (gap-1 on the rows container), like the dropdown. The inline caret carries .icon-stroke, so it draws the shared icon stroke (globals.css).
localPatches.src/components/dropdown.tsx: Popup rows sit 4px apart (gap-1 on the rows container), the spacing every list in the app uses. With a pinned search, the list fades below it (scroll-fade-under-search in globals.css) instead of dropping the fade.
localPatches.src/components/combobox.tsx: The inline caret carries .icon-stroke, so it draws the shared icon stroke (globals.css) instead of a 2 stroke.
localPatches.src/components/input-copy.tsx: The inline check and cross carry .icon-stroke, so they draw the shared icon stroke (globals.css) instead of a 2 stroke.
localPatches.src/components/menu-item.tsx: Optional `detail` prop: a muted caption after the label (filter value counts).
localPatches.src/components/dropdown-search.tsx: Optional `hideIcon` and `trailing` props, for the Linear-style filter field (no magnifier, a shortcut key on the right).

fluid.stylesheet: src/styles/globals.css follows the Fluid site app/globals.css at the same commit, minus site-only sections.

otherComponents.note: Components outside the Fluid registry. Each follows Fluid tokens (shape radius, type roles, hover/active, Elevated); replace with a Fluid equivalent when one ships.
